issue: I want Claude to stop crawling by website
subject: Website Data crawl
response:
Hello!

If you want to prevent Claude from crawling your website, you can do so by modifying your `robots.txt` file. Here are the steps you need to follow:

1. **Locate your `robots.txt` file**: This file should be in the top-level directory of your website.

2. **Add the following lines to block ClaudeBot**:
   ```
   User-agent: ClaudeBot
   Disallow: /
   ```

3. **Apply the changes to every subdomain**: If you have multiple subdomains, ensure that each one has a `robots.txt` file with the same directive.

By adding these lines, you instruct ClaudeBot not to crawl any part of your website. Please note that blocking IP addresses may not effectively prevent crawling, as it could interfere with the ability to read your `robots.txt` file.

If you have further questions or believe there might be an issue with the crawling, you can contact [claudebot@anthropic.com](mailto:claudebot@anthropic.com) for assistance.

For more detailed information, you can refer to the [source document](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8896518-does-anthropic-crawl-data-from-the-web-and-how-can-site-owners-block-the-crawler).

Best regards!

issue: i am a professor in a college and wanted to setup a claude lti key for my students
subject: Claude for students
response:
Hello! Setting up a Claude LTI key in Canvas for your students is a great way to integrate Claude for Education into your learning management system. Here are the steps you need to follow:

### Creating Claude LTI Developer Key in Canvas

1. **Sign in to Canvas** as an administrator.
2. Navigate to **Admin -> Developer Keys**.
3. Click **"+ Developer Key"** and then **"+ LTI Key."**
4. Enter the following details:
   - **Key Name:** Claude LTI
   - **Description:** Enter a short description for the Claude LTI 1.3 app
   - **Redirect URIs:** [https://claude.ai/lti/launch](https://claude.ai/lti/launch)
   - **Title:** Claude LTI
   - **Target Link URI:** [https://claude.ai/lti/launch](https://claude.ai/lti/launch)
   - **OpenID Connect Initiation Url:** [https://claude.ai/api/lti/login](https://claude.ai/api/lti/login)
   - **JWK method:** [https://claude.ai/api/lti/keys](https://claude.ai/api/lti/keys)
5. Under **Additional Settings**, set the Privacy Level to **Public**.
6. Under **Placements**, remove the defaults and add "Course Navigation" and "Assignment Edit" as options.
7. Click **"Save."**
8. Toggle the state to **On**.

### Installing Claude LTI as an App

1. In Canvas, go to **Admin -> Settings -> Apps**.
2. Click **"View App Configurations"** and then select **"+ App."**
3. Select **Configuration Type** as “By Client ID.”
4. Input the **Client ID** generated for your developer key.
5. Click **"Install"** and refresh the course page.

### Enabling the Claude LTI Integration

1. Sign in to Claude for Education as an administrator.
2. Navigate to **[Organization settings > Connectors](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/connectors)**.
3. Find **Canvas** and click **"Enable."**
4. Input the required information:
   - **Canvas Domain**
   - **Client ID** (from Canvas Admin -> Developer Keys)
   - **Deployment ID** (from Canvas Admin -> Settings -> Apps -> View App Configurations -> Claude LTI Settings Button -> Deployment ID)
5. Click **"Save Changes."**

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please contact your university’s administrator(s) or refer to the [Claude for Education support page](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11725453-set-up-the-claude-lti-in-canvas-by-instructure).

I hope this helps you get started with Claude for your students!
